$comment: Single source of the product's display name and public host. Change them with `node scripts/apply-brand.mjs "<New Name>"` / `node scripts/apply-brand.mjs --host <new.host>`, never by hand: the script rewrites every literal copy and this file; `prebuild` fails when a copy drifts. The name is TWO words; the UI shows it followed by the alpha badge. legacyHosts: older hosts that still serve (none since 2026-11-08: sc-companion.vercel.app and the star-citizen alias were removed without redirects). Technical ids (storage keys, URL scheme, user agent, package names) are NOT covered — see docs/rename-verse-companion.md, stage 2.
